mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate, compressing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points in one month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a sharp labor market contraction, which is a strong negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250.0) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), aggressive monetary tightening leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals weak residential demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls < 1200.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 109.0 indicates a supply-side contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls < 109.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above 1250.0, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 500000.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
